latest.title: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy has stroke and is in the hospital, office says
latest.description: Sen. Chris Murphy's office announced Sunday that he suffered a stroke and was hospitalized the day prior, though they say he is 'awake and alert.'

latest.title: Hong Kong takes tokenized settlement to 24/7, plans stablecoin trials
latest.description: The HKMA plans to bring regulated stablecoins into tokenized government debt trials, while HSBC says its RedCoin stablecoin has reached 50,000 users.

latest.title: BTC heads into US midterm showdown: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
latest.description: Bitcoin price action held its 100-day moving average into the monthly close as crypto markets braced for US midterm election and tech earnings volatility.

latest.title: Metals.io issues tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany
latest.description: The company is starting with $366,000 worth of copper stored in Germany, hoping to build a market for investors to own and trade physical metal onchain.

latest.title: Ryanair CEO warns fares could rise by up to 20% in 2027 as fuel bill jumps by $2.2 billion
latest.description: Ryanair's CEO Michael O'Leary told CNBC that European airlines may have "significantly higher airfares" of up to 20% next year as fuel costs rise.

latest.title: U.S. crude falls below $100 amid reports of U.S.-Iran diplomatic efforts
latest.description: Oil fell Monday, amid news that both the U.S. and Iran are pursuing diplomacy amid ongoing Mideast tensions

latest.title: OKX draws $445M in net inflows as Binance outflows exceed $7B

latest.title: Live updates: Binance records $6 billion outflows after starting withdrawals, less then 4% of total holdings
latest.description: The outflows followed a 45-hour withdrawal freeze after a $6.3 billion theft, with rival exchanges attracting deposits as customers regained access to their funds.

latest.title: China’s Communist Party calls for a crackdown on corruption that uses crypto and blockchain
latest.description: China's Communist Party has named virtual currency and blockchain in a new anti-corruption call.

latest.title: Why stealing billions from a crypto exchange can be harder to stop than a bank theft
latest.description: The $6.3 billion Binance breach has revived a debate over whether crypto exchanges are less secure than banks or simply harder to protect once hackers get inside.

latest.title: Bitcoin ETFs sink into October outflows with $643M exit after Binance hack
latest.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs ended October with $515 million in net withdrawals, while Ether funds posted a record $1.61 billion in monthly outflows.

latest.title: AI is coming to construction sites. But does it make workers safer?

latest.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $643 million in outflows Friday, and 2026 is barely green now
latest.description: The first trading day after the Binance hack saw the biggest ETF outflow since June 25.

latest.title: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget
latest.description: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, and will include a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.

latest.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software
latest.description: BTCPay Server urged operators to shut down their servers after receiving reports of unauthorized attackers draining funds from hot wallets.

latest.title: Strangers are begging the Binance hacker for bitcoin, one ‘help me bro’ at a time
latest.description: The 19 wallets holding 18,270 stolen BTC have taken in nothing since Thursday except payments worth under a dollar, each carrying a message, from pleas to laundering pitches to a token shill.

latest.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows as withdrawals resume after massive hack
